Package neqsim.process.processmodel.dexpi

Class Dexpi201ModelValidator

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.processmodel.dexpi.Dexpi201ModelValidator
public final class Dexpi201ModelValidator extends Object
Checks supported native exchanges against pinned official DEXPI 2.0.1 model declarations. Checks class and property identities, inheritance, property kinds, multiplicities, enumeration references, and typed object relationships. This is not CAE qualification.
Version:
1.0
Author:
NeqSim development team
